details.publicNotes:
Left behind by psychopomps as grisly warnings to pry no further, rictus masks are temporary beings who decay over time unless called upon to undo further rebels against death or guard a graveyard that has caught the interest of unsavory individuals.

Explorers who intrude upon lands where the dead slumber would do well to note any crumbling rooms in otherwise sound structures, and carefully avoid any suspicious areas of random decay hidden among otherwise healthy vegetation.

Rictus masks look like grimacing earthen death masks with closed eyes. The features of their face transform into a morbid facsimile of those of their most recent victim. When disturbed, a rictus mask opens their eyelids, revealing unsettlingly realistic eyeballs as dust rises and churns around them. Rictus masks relish opportunities to destroy undead. While they don't particularly enjoy killing living creatures, they don't hesitate to do so when living creatures threaten them or refuse to obey their orders to stay away from locations they protect.

Woe, Destruction, Ruin, and Decay

While the activities of some psychopomps are reasonably well-documented, reliable information concerning rictus masks is scarce, Those who escape a rictus mask's vengeance rarely speak of what they saw. Even fewer return to face the rictus mask again. No one wants to be confronted by their own dead face.

You force the target to see a vision of its own death. It takes 8d6 mental damage with a Will save. If the target is reduced to 0 HP by this spell, its vision becomes reality and kills it instantly.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes half damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target takes full damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target takes double damage, is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 4} and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for as long as it's frightened.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 2d6.

You conjure a large boulder in the air and send it crashing down to the ground. The boulder appears at the top of the cylinder before falling. Creatures underneath the boulder take 4d12 bludgeoning damage and must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage. If it was flying, it is repositioned to the bottom of the cylinder, landing on its feet without taking additional falling damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage. If it was flying, it is repositioned to the bottom of the cylinder, landing on its feet without taking additional falling damage. If it is on the ground after the boulder's fall, it is knocked @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If it's still in the air, it's instead @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round or until it spends an action to right itself, whichever comes first.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 and the cylinder's maximum height increases by 10 feet.

Using the weight of earth, you hamper a target's flight, with effects based on its Fortitude save. If the creature reaches the ground safely, it doesn't take falling damage.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target falls safely up to 120 feet.

Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 round.

Critical Failure The target falls safely up to 120 feet. If it hits the ground, it can't Fly, levitate, or otherwise leave the ground for 1 minute.

You plant fear in the target; it must attempt a Will save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2}.

Critical Failure The target is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 3} and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.sDPxOjQ9kx2RZE8D]{Fleeing} for 1 round.

Heightened (3rd) You can target up to five creatures.

The target's latch mechanism clinks shut, held fast by unseen magical wards. When you magically lock a target, you set an Athletics and Thievery DC to open it equal to your spell DC or the base lock DC with a +4 status bonus, whichever is higher. Any key or combination that once opened a lock affected by this spell does not do so for the duration of the spell, though the key or combination does grant a +4 circumstance bonus to checks to open the door. If the target is opened, the spell ends. Assuming the target is not barred or locked in some additional way, you can unlock and open it with an Interact action during which you touch the target. This does not end the spell. You can Dismiss this spell at any time and from any distance.

Heightened (2nd) The duration is unlimited, but you must expend 6 gp worth of precious metals as an additional cost.

target.value: 1 lock, or a door or container with a latch

You send out a pulse that registers the presence of magic. You receive no information beyond the presence or absence of magic. You can choose to ignore magic you're fully aware of, such as the magic items and ongoing spells of you and your allies. You detect illusion magic only if that magic's effect has a lower rank than the rank of your detect magic spell. However, items that have an illusion aura but aren't deceptive in appearance (such as an @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.bikFUFRLwfdvX2x2]{Invisibility Potion}) typically are detected normally.

Heightened (3rd) You learn the rank or level of the most powerful magical effect the spell detects, as determined by the GM.

Heightened (4th) As 3rd rank, but you also pinpoint the source of the highest-rank magic. Like for an imprecise sense, you don't learn the exact location, but can narrow down the source to within a 5-foot cube (or the nearest if larger than that).

You demolish the target's corrupted essence with energy from Creation's Forge. You deal 2d6 vitality damage with a basic Fortitude save. If the creature critically fails the save, it is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d6.

target.value: 1 creature that is undead or otherwise has void healing

You call upon the Void to harm life force. The target takes 2d4 void damage with a basic Fortitude save. On a critical failure, the target is also @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.MIRkyAjyBeXivMa7]{Enfeebled 1} until the start of your next turn.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d4.

Trigger A creature damages the rictus mask while the rictus mask is within 10 feet of a statue they created with their Echoes of the Damned ability

Effect The rictus mask causes one of their statues from Echoes of the Damned within 10 feet to explode, reducing the amount of damage the rictus mask takes by 10. The remnants of the statue gather on the rictus mask, reshaping their facial features to match the creature who triggered this reaction. The creature depicted on the mask doesn't reduce the value of their frightened condition automatically at the end of their turns until the mask takes on another person's appearance or 1 minute passes, whichever comes first.

The rictus mask creates two Medium statues within 10 feet. Each of these statues is a dusty facsimile of a creature that has previously taken damage from the rictus mask. The statues are inanimate objects with object immunities, 10 Hit Points, and 20 AC; for all other defensive statistics, they use the rictus mask's bonuses. If the rictus mask uses Echoes of the Damned again, any statues they previously created turn to dust.

The rictus mask accelerates time in a @Template[type:burst|distance:10] within 120 feet until the end of their next turn. Within this area, flesh falters, plants shrivel, and even stone begins to crumble. Any creature that enters or begins its turn in the area of accelerated time takes @Damage[8d6[force]|options:area-damage] damage (@Check[fortitude|dc:25|basic] save) and is then temporarily immune to this ability for 1 day. The rictus mask can Sustain the effect up to twice on future turns to extend its duration; each time they do, the radius increases by 10 feet.
